agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario has no pushes; with seeded sensor_noise=0.00537 the state-feedback controller trades cart position for pole balancing. Cart velocity becomes increasingly negative (-0.19 at step 100, -0.39 at step 200, -0.80 at step 300, -1.36 at step 374) while pole stays well within upright limit (margin ~0.72 rad). Controller force stays <1.1 N far below force_limit 51.86, so no saturation. The steady negative drift integrates over 4.7 s from x=-0.095 to x=-2.405, exiting the +/-2.4 track at step 374. Removing sensor noise eliminates the drift.
